method.name: BeginDelete
method.summary: Marks an existing item as pending deletion and returns its current instance identity.
method.param: Item identifier to mark for deletion.
method.returns: The same item identity for repeated calls, or null when absent.

method.name: FinalizeDelete
method.summary: Removes an item only when its token matches and it is pending deletion.
method.param: Expected token for the item instance being deleted.
method.returns: The finalization outcome, including absence, token mismatch, or a non-pending item.

method.name: GetPendingDeletes
method.summary: Returns a keyset-paged list of items pending deletion.
method.param: Exclusive item-ID continuation key, or null to start at the beginning.
Maximum number of items to return; must be between 1 and 100.
method.returns: A page of pending-delete item identities and the next continuation key.
